data.description:
Create the frontend project with the exact toolchain, the design tokens, the fonts, the pinned app shell and the Header. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §2, §3, §7.6, §10 (proxy). Design: BRANDING.md §2.1 (tokens), §2.5, §3.1 (fonts), §3.2 (scale), §4 (grid, shell, breakpoints), §5.1 (Header). Reference rendering: docs/branding-demo.html.

Why: every component task (BC-9, BC-10, BC-11) needs tokens, the type scale and the test harness in place, and the shell grid is what makes "app, not document" true.

Scope:
- `npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts`, then pin latest stable: React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript 7, Vitest 5, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/user-event, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-react-hooks, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, prettier. No other runtime or dev dependencies.
- tsconfig strict plus noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes. ESLint flat config. .prettierrc. vitest config with jsdom and src/test/setup.ts (jest-dom matchers).
- vite.config.ts: proxy /api and /healthz to VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET, default http://localhost:8080.
- index.html: `<title>Brillio Listings</title>`, the BRANDING §3.1 Google Fonts link, lang="en".
- src/styles/tokens.css: the §2.1 :root block verbatim, plus `--font-display`, `--font-ui`, the §3.2 sizes/leading as custom properties, spacing (8px grid, 24/16px gutters, 1040px content width, 760px breakpoint noted in a comment since media queries cannot read custom properties).
- src/styles/global.css: html/body height 100% and overflow hidden, paper background, ink text, Figtree body at 15/22, `font-optical-sizing: auto`, `color-scheme: light`, a `.tabular` utility, reset for buttons/inputs to inherit font.
- src/styles/shell.module.css: §4.2 grid with rows `auto auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto`, results region `overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain`, 1040px centered content, gutters per §4.1.
- src/components/Header: wordmark BRILLIO LISTINGS per §3.2 (Figtree 13/600, +0.16em, uppercase), optional scope label at right in ink-2, 56px tall, hairline below. Test: renders wordmark and optional scope.
- App.tsx renders the shell with Header and placeholder regions labelled by role.
- Makefile: dev-web (npm run dev), frontend halves of test, lint (eslint + tsc --noEmit + prettier --check), check.

Acceptance:
- `npm run dev` shows the header on paper ground with the fonts loaded (check computed font-family in devtools).
- `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `make lint` all pass.
- package.json contains only the listed dependencies.
- No emoji anywhere (BRANDING §8).

Validation: open http://localhost:5173 in a browser (c11-browser skill), confirm the header renders and the document itself does not scroll; attach a screenshot with --role validation.

data.body: Operator ruling 2026-10-14: pin TypeScript 6.0.3 (not 7). TS 7.0.2 exports no classic compiler API and typescript-eslint 8.71.2 peers typescript <6.1.0. SPEC §2 and .lattice/context.md amended before the bootstrap commit. Use typescript@6.0.3 exactly; everything else latest stable.

plan-review fallback: headless lattice plan-review --mode single hit the 600s watchdog (exit 142; review-status: holder pid gone, no result recorded). Spawned a fresh-context plan-review sub-agent instead.

Plan-review triage (cycle 1, fallback review art_01M4W1VMFHB6FMYMB8P8981EAT, APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES): 10 findings, all obvious, applied in the plan's AUTHORITATIVE resolutions block. Majors: Makefile sentinel is node_modules/.package-lock.json (empty Compose volume dir no longer fools make); font proof uses document.fonts.load().length + FontFace status instead of fonts.check(); SPEC edits §2 (ESLint 9.39.5 held for jsx-a11y peer ^9; @types/node 24.x tracks Node 24) and §8 (tsc -b --noEmit). Minors: keep react-hooks recommended config, BC-8 uses useReducer/dispatch for §7.2; padding check honors the 760px breakpoint; row components pad themselves, shell .row is placeholder-only. Nits: dummy proxy port 18007, peer-range notes corrected, T2 asserts textContent, emoji regex widened. No evolutionary or complex findings; nothing deferred.

Code review routing (art_01M4W2SMAMFTH2Z6WCYBSQM2T8, PASS, Reviewed HEAD 1d6008a; reviewer read the full diff in the worktree because the prompt diff was truncated inside package-lock.json). (1) MINOR tsconfig.app.json lib omits DOM.Iterable: skipped, no change needed. TS 6.0's lib.dom.d.ts already includes the iterable declarations; a probe with for...of over URLSearchParams and NodeListOf, Object.fromEntries(params) and [...list] passes tsc -b --noEmit (exit 0) with lib [ES2023, DOM]. (2) MINOR .results scrollbar narrows the right edge on classic-scrollbar platforms: skipped with justification, deliberate plan decision 8 (scrollbar stays at the viewport edge; alternatives misalign the left edge). Hand-off note for BC-10/BC-14: check the right-aligned price block against the Header scope label with always-visible scrollbars.

Exact-head code review routing (art_01M4W3KK82ANSRJRSAXKGYGDWG, PASS, Reviewed HEAD 0d1c2a2 after merging master/BC-2): (1) MINOR App.test.tsx toEqual on DOM nodes is structural (isEqualNode), not identity: skipped with justification. Today's five placeholders are structurally distinct and getByRole throws on duplicates, so the order assertion holds; BC-12 replaces App.tsx and rewrites this test. Hand-off note for BC-12: assert shell children by identity (toBe). The reviewer also confirmed both earlier routings (DOM.Iterable not needed under TS 6.0; scrollbar trade-off).

BC-7 complete, at in_validation, handed to the Orchestrator for landing. Branch feat/BC-7-frontend-scaffold HEAD 0d1c2a2 (61b8f1d feat(frontend) scaffold; 1d6008a docs(spec); 0d1c2a2 merge of master after BC-2 landed).
BUILT: frontend/ Vite 8.3.4 + React 19.3.0 + TypeScript 6.0.3 (tsc --version verified) project from create-vite 9.2.1 react-ts, pruned (oxlint, template assets, CSS and README removed); strict tsconfigs plus noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes; type-aware ESLint 9 flat config (typescript-eslint recommendedTypeChecked, react-hooks recommended, jsx-a11y recommended); Prettier; Vitest 5 + jsdom + RTL + jest-dom with src/test/setup.ts; vite.config.ts proxy for /api and /healthz to VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET (default http://localhost:8080); index.html with title, lang and the BRANDING 3.1 fonts link; src/styles/tokens.css (2.1 block byte-for-byte, 3.1 families, 3.2 scale, 4.x spacing, 760px breakpoint), global.css, shell.module.css (4.2 grid); Header (wordmark h1 plus optional scope); placeholder App with five labelled regions; Makefile BC-7 block (dev-web, lint-web, test-web plus npm ci sentinel).
GATE: full make check exit 0 at HEAD 0d1c2a2 (golangci-lint 0 issues, 3 Go packages ok; eslint, tsc -b, prettier clean; vitest 2 files and 4 tests passed); npm run build exit 0.
NON-ALLOWLISTED PACKAGES (toolchain-required, per plan table): react-dom (React DOM renderer, RTL peer); @vitejs/plugin-react (template JSX transform and Fast Refresh for Vite 8); @types/react and @types/react-dom (React ships no types; strict tsc needs them); @types/node 24.19.2 (template tsconfig.node.json types for vite.config.ts; 24.x tracks the Node 24 runtime); eslint 9.39.5 (runner the listed plugins peer on). @testing-library/dom is lockfile-only as a required peer.
DEVIATIONS / SPEC EDITS: SPEC 2 note: ESLint held at 9.39.5 because eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y 6.10.2 peers eslint up to ^9 (Orchestrator ACK, run-state decision 01:57Z); @types/node tracks Node 24. SPEC 8: typecheck is tsc -b --noEmit (plain tsc --noEmit on the solution tsconfig checks nothing). Validation used port 15107, not 5173 (run-state). Wordmark DOM text is 'Brillio Listings' uppercased by CSS, as in docs/branding-demo.html.
REVIEWS: plan review (fallback sub-agent after the headless watchdog) art_01M4W1VMFHB6FMYMB8P8981EAT, 10 findings applied; code review art_01M4W2SMAMFTH2Z6WCYBSQM2T8 PASS at 1d6008a; exact-head re-review art_01M4W3KK82ANSRJRSAXKGYGDWG PASS at 0d1c2a2. All findings routed (no changes needed, or hand-off notes).
VALIDATION: art_01M4W345316DKA55J6NMBF5X4J (BC-7-validation.md, PASS at 1d6008a: paper ground, ink text, 56px header with hairline, Figtree 600 wordmark, Figtree and Bodoni Moda FontFaces loaded, 24px gutter at 763px, landmark order, document does not scroll while main does), art_01M4W3456KMT9CJTQZ44TK81QV (header screenshot), art_01M4W39TDPTX0KHPDEPP84NS3K (addendum PASS at 0d1c2a2: frontend and docs trees identical, served app, proxy and gate re-proven).
HAND-OFF NOTES: BC-8: implement SPEC 7.2 with useReducer and dispatch in the effect (react-hooks set-state-in-effect is on at error level; no inline disables). BC-9..BC-12: row components are direct children of the shell grid and apply padding-inline: var(--inline-pad) and their own hairlines; shell .row is only for the BC-7 placeholders. BC-10/BC-14: check the right-aligned price block against the Header scope label with always-visible scrollbars (results scrollbar sits inside the padded scroller). BC-12: when replacing App.test.tsx, assert shell children by identity (toBe). Follow-up tickets created: none.
